  tail: - Flushes and `os.fsync`s the file data before it is published. | - Publishes with `os.replace(tmp, target)` — atomic overwrite on both POSIX and Windows, so a crash leaves either the complete old report or the complete new on | - Restores the target's original file mode on the temp file (no-op-ish on Windows), deletes the temp file if anything goes wrong, and best-effort fsyncs the dir | - Uses `os.path.abspath` so relative paths still resolve to a valid temp directory. | Verification: `verify` (the fixed check) passes — 2 tests, OK. Note that this suite also passed **before** any change, so it does not by itself prove the fix. I
